title: Encoding, Decodability, and Use: A Five-Layer Framework for Benchmark Measurement Audits with Evidence from UAV Intent Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.22434v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Benchmark accuracy is routinely read as evidence that a model understands the construct the benchmark measures. We propose and instantiate on AeroIntent a five-layer framework that decomposes that reading into observation, representation, decoding, use, and behaviour. The framework separates encoding, decodability, and use as distinct levels. In the instantiation, the observation layer is unreliable on 7 of the 20 Drone programs and floors the direct visual correlate of radial velocity at a 0.26\% scale change. The representation layer exposes two task-designed RGB features with nominal signals. RAFT flow radial bias reaches $r=+0.257$ ($p=0.030$), and bounding-box optical-flow divergence reaches $r=+0.203$ ($p=0.029$). No multi-feature readout gives a fold-mean test correlation above the cluster minimum detectable effect (MDE), and the largest positive global out-of-sample correlation is $r=+0.080$. translated_title: 编码、可解码性与使用：一个用于基准测量审计的五层框架——来自无人机意图识别的证据
translated_abstract: 基准准确率通常被解读为模型理解了基准所测量构念的证据。我们在 AeroIntent 上提出并实例化了一个五层框架，将这种解读分解为观测、表示、解码、使用和行为。该框架将编码、可解码性和使用区分为不同的层级。在实例化中，观测层在 20 个 Drone 程序中的 7 个上不可靠，并将径向速度的直接视觉相关性下限锁定在 0.26% 的尺度变化上。表示层揭示了两个仅具名义信号的任务设计 RGB 特征：RAFT 光流径向偏差达到 r=+0.257（p=0.030），边界框光流散度达到 r=+0.203（p=0.029）。没有任何多特征读出在折平均测试相关性上超过聚类的最小可检测效应（MDE），且最大的正的全局样本外相关性仅为 r=+0.080。解码层将 MDE 设定在……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个将基准测量审计分解为观测、表示、解码、使用与行为五个层级的框架，并通过无人机意图识别基准 AeroIntent 的实证表明，基准高分并不等于模型真正理解了所测量的构念。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a five-layer framework decomposing benchmark measurement audits into observation, representation, decoding, use, and behaviour, demonstrating through UAV intent recognition evidence that high benchmark scores do not imply genuine understanding of the measured construct.
